user.title: House Consumption Forecaster Setup
user.description: Configure input sensors for energy prediction and adaptive self-learning.

data_description.consumption_sensor: Historical / daily house energy consumption in kWh (cumulative daily total).
data_description.solar_actual_sensor: Daily actual solar production in kWh used to compute the solar dependence factor.
data_description.solar_forecast_today: Expected solar generation forecast for today from Solcast / Volcast.
data_description.solar_forecast_tomorrow: Expected solar generation forecast for tomorrow from Solcast / Volcast.
data_description.weather_entity: Weather integration entity providing daily temperature forecasts for heating/cooling offsets.
data_description.history_days: Number of most recent days used to compute the rolling consumption and solar averages. A smaller value (e.g. 5) reacts faster to recent changes in usage habits; a larger value (e.g. 14-21) gives a smoother, less noisy forecast. Defaults to 10.

init.title: Reconfigure Sensors
